inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text: Homan’s refusal to rule out immigration enforcement at polling places looks less like an accidental mixed message and more like a way to keep voters guessing. The administration’s inconsistent answers create exactly the kind of uncertainty that can intimidate people, while asking what Democrats are “afraid of” turns scrutiny into a political distraction. The ambiguity itself is doing work.
